brief_rationale: The doctor successfully completed all responsibility-chain requirements with no errors, and achieved two high-order points (HO3 false-positive verification and HO4 dynamic reprioritization) with meaningful trajectory impact. However, HO1 (lung nodule misinformation correction) and HO2 (hidden state discovery on medication/document confusion) were not meaningfully triggered—the doctor never proactively corrected the lung nodule understanding despite workspace evidence, and did not systematically separate the pre-operative/medication items from home-care tasks.

high_order_assessment.explanation: The doctor never proactively corrected the lung nodule misunderstanding. The workspace showed lung nodules with '建议密切随访' but the doctor never addressed this, never corrected potential 'nodule=metastasis' misconception, and did not integrate this into the plan despite having access to the records.

The doctor did not systematically separate the confused documents. The workspace showed '术前带药：头孢唑林针1.0g ivgtt术前半小时' (pre-operative only) and the family mentioned unclear medication records, but the doctor did not proactively clarify which items were home-care vs. hospital-only. The doctor responded to family questions but did not actively discover and address the document confusion beyond reactive replies.
